title: Streaming algorithms for robust max-min diversification
abstract: arXiv:2610.01456v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Given a set of $n$ points $X$ in a metric space and an integer $k$, max-min diversification aims to select $k$ points of $X$ maximizing their minimum pairwise distance. This objective function is however highly vulnerable to noisy points. In[Amagata, AAAI23], a robust formulation is proposed which addresses this vulnerability by excluding solutions containing any of $z$ outliers, defined as the $z$ points in $X$ with the largest nearest-neighbor distances. That paper also presents a coreset-based streaming algorithm for the new formulation, based on a suitable inlier-outlier separation assumption. translated_title: 鲁棒最大-最小多样化的流式算法
translated_abstract: 给定度量空间中的n个点组成的集合X和一个整数k，最大-最小多样化旨在从X中选择k个点，使其最小成对距离最大化。然而，该目标函数对噪声点高度敏感。[Amagata, AAAI23]提出了一种鲁棒的表述形式，通过排除包含任意z个离群点的解来解决这一脆弱性，其中离群点被定义为X中最近邻距离最大的z个点。该文还基于一个合理的内点-离群点分离假设，为新表述提出了一种基于核心集的流式算法。然而，我们发现了[Amagata, AAAI23]算法的三个缺点：其核心集构建需要对X进行离线计算，需要与n成线性关系的内存，这与流处理的典型目标形成鲜明对比；用于从核心集提取解的单遍过程可能返回少于k个点（
tldr: 本文指出了[Amagata, AAAI23]中基于核心集的鲁棒最大-最小多样化流式算法存在的三个缺陷，包括离线计算导致线性内存开销以及解提取过程可能返回不足k个点等问题，并据此提出改进的流式算法。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies three shortcomings of the coreset-based streaming algorithm in [Amagata, AAAI23] for robust max-min diversification—such as offline computation requiring linear memory and solution extraction possibly returning fewer than k points—and proposes improved streaming algorithms.
